scope: mao C00-C08 current first-round evidence semantics

first_failure.finding: Wrong/Uncertain events preserved subject/chapter/unit/question/outcome/choice/answer but did not preserve the owning repair-source locator independently of mutable last_location.

repair.behavior: Enrich the matching newest WRONG/UNCERTAIN evidence event with repair_source_anchor and Current source-owner ids derived from the owning Mao Unit.

browser_journey_assertions: clean STABLE first attempts create no Wrong/Uncertain repair debt
STABLE and Unit Return explicitly preserve no-mastery semantics
WRONG first-attempt truth survives repair and cannot be overwritten
UNCERTAIN remains distinct even when the selected answer is correct
repair-source anchor and stable source-owner ids travel with the evidence event
Return Packet event provenance remains correct after last_location moves to another Mao chapter
forced first-attempt persistence failure is visible and fails closed
failed persistence cannot manufacture a first attempt, close the Unit, or advance the cursor to UNIT_RETURN

boundaries.later_transfer_rule: Future fresh/holdout evidence may strengthen or challenge earlier evidence but must append/reconcile rather than overwrite first-attempt truth.
